name: Zyphari
notes: Insectoid, highly communal beings emphasizing long-term investment and economic dominance; the dominant species of the Zyphari corporate confederation (which is itself multispecies). Primary polity: Zyphari Compact.

naming_exemption.reason: Species name "Zyphari" preserved verbatim from the cited species/civilization codex.

distribution: Dominant species of the Zyphari Compact, but the Compact is explicitly MULTISPECIES — Zyphari are its most prominent members, not its only ones. Zyphari also appear in Union trade contexts.
identity_model_note: Species = a people (biology + broad cultural origin). Membership is not bounded by any single polity/faction; see member_polities (non-exhaustive) and distribution.

promotion_to_canon.rule: owner directive: promote all staged records that do not conflict with canon
promotion_to_canon.conflict_scan: zero name/office collisions; fabric linter clean; position axis unchanged

origin_polity_id_note: origin_polity_id carries the FACTION-binding form ("zyphari_compact"), which is also what polity_zyphari_compact.faction_bindings uses — so the value is meaningful, not a typo. It is simply not an entity id. origin_polity_entity_id is added alongside rather than rewriting it, the same additive pattern used when entity_id was added beside canonical_id, so neither namespace is lost.
